data.one_liner: Expresses a DateTime object relative to the current time in text form.
data.what_it_does: Transforms DateTime objects into relative text representations such as '3 years ago' or 'in 42 minutes'. It supports a large number of localized languages and can use natural language or numeric expressions.
use_when: You need to display relative timestamps like '5 minutes ago' in a Flutter app.
Your app requires internationalized relative time formatting across many languages.
avoid_when: You only need absolute date and time formatting.
You want a zero-dependency Dart-only utility without Flutter localization requirements.
strengths: Supports a massive list of languages extracted from the Unicode CLDR Project.
Offers both class instances and convenient DateTime extension methods.
Allows customization of allowed time units and numeric versus natural phrasing.
weaknesses: Relies on Flutter localization delegates for full BuildContext integration.
Automated translations mean PRs for language updates are not accepted.
data.setup_notes: Add RelativeTimeLocalizations.delegate to your MaterialApp localizationsDelegates.
